senses.gloss:
जेह् जेह् (related to 1. जभ् and जृभ्),
cl. 1. A., Ved. जेहते, जिजेहे, जेहिष्यते,
जेहितुम्, to open the mouth, breathe heavily, gasp,
gape, open wide, yawn; (Sāy.) to reach, go towards,
strive after: Caus. जेहयति, अजिजेहत्.

जेहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, gaping, opening wide;
(Sāy.) going towards.
